night.displayName: Night (shift blue, shared with the wall)

body.purpose: Prose; body-sm for the secondary layer.

label-xs.purpose: The one role tracked OUT (caps): section kickers and nav group heads.

shadows.name: shadow-1
shadows.purpose: Subtle lift for a card that must read as pickable, and the focused skip link. Not default.

shadows.name: shadow-2
shadows.purpose: The modal drawer and the layout editor's widget sheet — surfaces that overlay content.

motion.name: dur-1
motion.purpose: A control acknowledging a press (field label/border, small state).

motion.name: dur-2
motion.purpose: A panel opening, a state layer, the nav bar / inspector.

motion.name: dur-3
motion.purpose: A sheet travelling the height of a phone.

motion.name: ease-out
motion.purpose: Enters (a panel/inspector opening, a tab underline).

motion.name: reduced-motion-gate
motion.purpose: EVERY transition and animation lives inside this one block, so a reduced-motion visitor gets a still admin.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The filled action: accent ground, accent-ink label. Hover/press are color-mix washes; keyboard focus draws a ring.
components.css: .ds-btn { font-family: Roboto, system-ui, sans-serif; font-weight: 600; font-size: 14.5px; height: 40px; padding: 0 16px; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; border: none; border-radius: 4px; background: #E8A33D; color: #241703; cursor: pointer; } .ds-btn:hover { background: color-mix(in srgb, #E8A33D 94%, #000); } .ds-btn:active { background: color-mix(in srgb, #E8A33D 89%, #000); } .ds-btn:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #E8A33D; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Ghost Button
components.description: Outlined secondary. Clears the filled ground, so it must also clear the filled hover/press (else it flashes gold-on-gold on touch).
components.css: .ds-btn-ghost { font-family: Roboto, system-ui, sans-serif; font-weight: 600; font-size: 14.5px; height: 40px; padding: 0 16px; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; border: 1px solid #3D444D; border-radius: 4px; background: transparent; color: #E8A33D; cursor: pointer; } .ds-btn-ghost:hover { background: color-mix(in srgb, #E8A33D 6%, transparent); } .ds-btn-ghost:active { background: color-mix(in srgb, #E8A33D 11%, transparent); } .ds-btn-ghost:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #E8A33D; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Tonal Button
components.description: A weightier secondary: soft accent ground, soft-accent ink.
components.css: .ds-btn-tonal { font-family: Roboto, system-ui, sans-serif; font-weight: 600; font-size: 14.5px; height: 40px; padding: 0 16px; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; border: none; border-radius: 4px; background: #3B3226; color: #F3C079; cursor: pointer; } .ds-btn-tonal:hover { background: color-mix(in srgb, #3B3226 92%, #fff); } .ds-btn-tonal:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #E8A33D; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Text Field
components.description: Label ABOVE a bordered input (not a floating label). Focus shifts the border to accent; the border width is not transitioned (a 1px→2px step would shimmer). 16px text avoids iOS zoom.
components.css: .ds-field { display: block; font-family: Roboto, system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-field-label { display: block; font-size: 13.5px; font-weight: 600; color: #E9EBEE; margin-bottom: 8px; } .ds-field-input { width: 100%; height: 44px; padding: 0 12px; font-size: 16px; color: #E9EBEE; background: transparent; border: 1px solid #7C848E; border-radius: 4px; } .ds-field-input::placeholder { color: #8E97A3; } .ds-field-input:focus { outline: none; border-color: #E8A33D; }

components.name: Card
components.description: A settings card: surface ground, hairline, 8px radius, 16px padding. Separated from the page by a ground step, not a shadow.
components.css: .ds-card { font-family: Roboto, system-ui, sans-serif; background: #1A1D22; border: 1px solid #2E333A; border-radius: 8px; padding: 16px; color: #E9EBEE; } .ds-card-h { margin: 0; font-size: 16px; line-height: 22px; font-weight: 650; letter-spacing: -0.005em; } .ds-card-p { margin: 4px 0 0; font-size: 12.5px; line-height: 18px; color: #8E97A3; }

components.name: Tag
components.description: A tinted status chip (soft ground + hue), never a solid fill. A state is a tag, never a parenthesis baked into a heading. Tones: neutral / ok / warn / danger.
components.html: Connected Syncing Failed Off
components.css: .ds-tag { font-family: Roboto, system-ui, sans-serif; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; height: 22px; padding: 0 8px; border-radius: 4px; font-size: 12px; font-weight: 600; background: #22262C; color: #A9B0B9; } .ds-tag-ok { background: #253A33; color: #5FD08A; } .ds-tag-warn { background: #3C3523; color: #F0B429; } .ds-tag-bad { background: #3F2E31; color: #FF8A80; }

components.name: Nav Item
components.description: A sidebar row: 48px, ink-2 label, a 2px accent bar for the active route (not a tinted pill). Hover is a wash.
components.html: CalendarsWallsSystem
components.css: .ds-nav { font-family: Roboto, system-ui, sans-serif; display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 2px; } .ds-nav-item { position: relative; display: flex; align-items: center; height: 48px; padding: 0 12px; border-radius: 4px; color: #A9B0B9; text-decoration: none; font-size: 14.5px; } .ds-nav-item:hover { background: color-mix(in srgb, #E9EBEE 6%, transparent); } .ds-nav-item.is-on { color: #E9EBEE; } .ds-nav-item.is-on::before { content: ""; position: absolute; left: 0; top: 12px; bottom: 12px; width: 2px; border-radius: 2px; background: #E8A33D; }

narrative.overview: This is the settings surface for a fixture in a house — the wizard that stands the wall up and the admin that keeps it running — and it is built to look like one. A household opens it briefly, months apart, usually on a phone in a kitchen in the evening, so the register is calm, precise, and hand-set: neutral grounds, exactly one brand hue, and a small, reviewable vocabulary. The defining decision is that the tokens are hand-picked facts, not generated outputs; this replaced a Material 3 tonal palette that tinted every surface with the brand seed and read as an app wearing somebody's wallpaper. The confirmed anti-reference is exactly that Material tonal wallpaper. It is a modern-browser surface (color-mix, :has()), and it is the one place in the product that permits motion — a settings screen is something a person is touching, where ~180ms confirms a tap landed — which is the deliberate inverse of the wall, and all of it lives inside a single prefers-reduced-motion: no-preference block.
keyCharacteristics: Hand-picked tokens as reviewable facts; nothing is generated or seed-tinted.
Neutral grounds, one brand hue; a small vocabulary, not a tonal sprawl.
Two full schemes (dark default, light), one set of component rules across both.
Phone-first: 44/48px targets, 16px inputs, a script-free modal drawer, a skip link.
Motion allowed but pointer-scoped and reduced-motion-gated — the inverse of the wall.
Depth is a hairline and a ground step; two single-layer shadows, only for surfaces that truly float.

rules.name: The Hand-Picked Rule
rules.body: Colours are facts, not outputs. Nothing regenerates them; changing one is a reviewable diff, held by a contrast test.

rules.name: The One-Hue Rule
rules.body: Exactly one hue carries the brand; every other surface is a true neutral. The admin is a fixture, not an app wearing wallpaper.

rules.name: The Ink-Line Rule
rules.body: ink-line is the single role allowed below 4.5:1, and it draws control boundaries only — never text.

rules.name: The Legible-Heading Rule
rules.body: Headings are weight 650 with negative tracking, not airy 400. A settings screen must read at a glance, sometimes across a kitchen.

rules.name: The Muted-Floor Rule
rules.body: A sentence is never set below ink-muted; ink-line is a border colour, not a text colour.

rules.name: The Token-Spacing Rule
rules.body: Every spacing, radius, and font-size is a token — no raw pixel literals. A drift test fails the build on one.

rules.name: The Script-Free-Nav Rule
rules.body: The mobile drawer and the wizard run with zero JavaScript. Someone who cannot reach the navigation cannot reach anything else.

rules.name: The Two-Shadow Rule
rules.body: Shadows are single-layer and reserved for the modal drawer and the widget sheet. Everything else separates by ground step and hairline.

rules.name: The No-Pill Rule
rules.body: full radius is for circles only. A rounded-rectangle pill button or nav row is banned — that was the Material look this system removed.

dos: Do compose every screen from the component vocabulary; spend tokens, never raw px/radius/font-size literals.
Do keep colours hand-picked and contrast-tested; add every role to both schemes.
Do convey depth with a ground step and a hairline; reserve the two shadows for the drawer and the widget sheet.
Do put every transition inside prefers-reduced-motion: no-preference, on the three duration / three easing tokens.
Do set a sentence in ink-muted at the quietest; keep ink-line for control borders only.
Do use 44/48px targets and 16px inputs; keep the wizard and mobile nav script-free.
Do show state as a tag, and write empty states that name the list and match the handler's branch.
donts: Don't reintroduce a Material tonal palette, a 15-role scale, an elevation ladder, or pill-shaped nav/buttons.
Don't use full radius on anything that isn't a circle.
Don't let a control that clears the filled button keep the filled hover/press (gold-on-gold on touch).
Don't set text in ink-line, or a sentence below ink-muted.
Don't bake a state into a heading's text ('(off)') — use a tag.
Don't put an icon, illustration, or cheer in an empty state.
Don't copy the walked-down light accent back to the brand amber, or add a raw one-off spacing/radius/font-size value.
